-- Migration: backfill customer loyalty level from legacy_code.
-- Mapping per codes.csv: A -> gold, B -> silver, C -> bronze.

BEGIN;

-- 1. Add the new loyalty column (idempotent: safe to re-run).
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reward_band TEXT;

-- 2. Backfill it from legacy_code. Codes with no mapping stay NULL.
UPDATE customers
SET reward_band = CASE legacy_code
                     WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
                     WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
                     WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
                   END
WHERE reward_band IS NULL
  AND legacy_code IS NOT NULL;

COMMIT;
